chapter_title_en: The Cage Closes on Five Immortals
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 450 – Ji Ning Traps 5 Celestial Immortals in a Brutal Power Clash
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning springs his trap on the five Celestial Immortals of the Shao'yan clan. A tactical battle of wills and raw power begins.
og_title: Ji Ning Lures the Five Celestial Immortals into His Trap
og_description: A tactical masterpiece as Ji Ning faces five top-tier foes in his prepared formation.
twitter_description: Ji Ning goads his enemies into a trap and shows them the true gap in power.

lore_anchors.definition: The seventh major realm in Ki Refining, signifying an immortal who has transcended the Three Realms and achieved eternal life.
The five top-tier cultivators of the Shao'yan clan in this chapter: Huoba, Chixin, Jingyu, Kuumu, and Jinzhong.
A formation from the Primordial Fiendgod Era, designed to bind and capture powerful Fiendgods using five synergistic black chain treasures.

surfaces: Mountain of Five Elements Defensive Formation
lore_anchors.definition: A common defensive formation in the Three Realms, where five cultivators merge their power to create a near-impenetrable five-colored mountain.
Ji Ning's acquired river-type magic treasure, used to entangle and slow enemies with its infinitely malleable water.
A long-range attack technique or magical treasure that Mu Northson possesses.
A being born from primordial chaos, known for immense physical power and resilience. Ji Ning is a Fiendgod Body Refiner.
A classic Xianxia divine ability that allows a cultivator to manifest additional heads and arms for simultaneous attacks and defense.
